phases.title: R1.5 Cloud software qualification
phases.environment: BL: qualified Cloud browser/CLI, isolated fixtures/backend and executed pinned reference
acceptance: Rehearse the imported-SVG and starter-to-rundown journeys cumulatively on the tested candidate, verifying the applicable E1-E4 software contracts, source/assets/operator fields, history, save/reopen, rehearsal and browser exports. Run comparable tasks in the executed pinned reference and retain exact sources, deliberate differences and prior failures.

Measure F4's 30-layer/300-key scene at 1366x768 and 1920x1080 on the recorded Cloud worker, with actual zoom/resource settings, raw feedback distributions and rendered captures. Investigate software regressions against the existing targets; Cloud diagnostics do not replace E5's named-device measurements or actual native 125% zoom.

Resolve known release-critical Cloud-reproducible software gaps within existing repair/check limits, retain independently verified evidence, and prepare a ready-to-run final local qualification kit: candidate/fixtures, short introduction, both participant journeys, timing/error/assistance forms and device/reference instructions. Participant or desktop availability is not a Cloud exit condition.

phases.title: R1.5 Cloud export and receiving preparation
phases.environment: BL: qualified Cloud Linux/browser/export fixtures and available isolated renderer tools
acceptance: Generate the exact candidate packages for every proposed release target with a bundled font and logo. Verify available browser/isolated-renderer data, In, Next, Out, interruption, replay, asset/source preservation and expected output; record executed versions and limits without claiming named real receiving-host acceptance.

Investigate #775 on Cloud Linux where its path is reachable, fix proven software defects within existing limits, and prepare a reproducible long-text/font fixture and expected fit measurements for the applicable named Linux receiver. Preserve unavailable native-host evidence as an E6 requirement; a browser or Cloud fixture cannot close real-host fit.

Complete the technical G07 artifact/notices/provenance/dependency-boundary audit, preserving unresolved written GSAP disposition for OW1. Stage a consolidated final local kit with exact packages/checksums, compatibility scope, clean receiving setup/version checklist, operator data and In/Next/Out/interruption scripts, expected captures/resource observations and off-air/rollback procedure. Host/operator availability and the vendor reply do not block this preparation.

revise.environment: BL: qualified Cloud browser/CLI with an isolated authenticated backend on the worker or GitHub Actions
